feeds.title: Book of Centuries
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Laurie. I work to give children fully human lives, awake to wonder and surprise. We are so accustomed to taking wonders as matters, of course, mere everyday events, that it does not occur to us to be surprised. A Charlotte Mason education leads to all kinds of ideas! Join me in keeping one or several of the notebooks she prescribed and discover the Science of Relations and the Art of Mindfulness.

feeds.title: My Little Robins Blog
feeds.description: I'm Leah, a former teacher, and current stay-at-home mom. I realized that there was very little information about using Charlotte Mason in the early years. Hence this blog. I want to share with you different topics and perspectives.

feeds.title: AmblesideOnline
feeds.description: AmblesideOnline is a free homeschool curriculum that uses Charlotte Mason's classically-based principles to prepare children for a life of rich relationships with everything around them: God, humanity, and the natural world. We host a large collection of original Charlotte Mason materials, which have been digitized by our volunteers.

feeds.title: Joyous Lessons Blog
feeds.description: Sharing the joys of a Catholic Charlotte Mason education at home. I'm Celeste, mom to ten children, fifteen and under, and Charlotte Mason homeschooler. Once upon a time, I was studying to be an English professor; now I'm a homeschool mother grateful for the philosophy of Charlotte Mason.

feeds.title: Homeschool Ways
feeds.description: Hi! I am Adriana Zoder, a polyglot, homeschooling mom, author, speaker, blogger, and newspaper columnist. This blog tells the story of our homeschooling journey while sharing ideas and information relating to homeschooling in general. I review curriculum, books, and educational kits, and experiment with different schedules and methods.

feeds.title: Our Journey Westward Blog
feeds.description: I'm Cindy West, a busy homeschooling mom to three active and wonderful children. We identify most with the Charlotte Mason style of schooling. Our Journey Westward exists to encourage parents to homeschool creatively, abundantly, and joyfully. In our blog, we talk about education creatively and practically.

feeds.title: Heritage Mom Blog
feeds.description: My name is Amber O'Neal Johnston, and I started this blog as a way to document and discuss the joys and trials of raising my kids to love themselves and others. Along with advice and inspiration, I as a mom of four offer a path forward for parents of all backgrounds who are craving a life-giving home that fosters values of diversity, kinship, equity, and inclusion.

feeds.title: Sabbath Mood Homeschool Blog
feeds.description: I am Nicole Williams, I have learned a lot about the methods Charlotte Mason employed for teaching science. I hope to help you by elucidating those ideas and by providing a living science curriculum that you can use.

feeds.title: Brighter Day Press Blog
feeds.description: HI! I am Whitney, a pastor's wife, a Charlotte Mason fan, and a homeschooling mama to four incredible children. Brighter Day Press exists to equip and inspire parents to teach in their homes with confidence, creativity, and truth.

feeds.title: Homeschool Nature Study
feeds.description: We are veteran homeschool moms sharing homeschool nature study resources to bless your homeschool. We will help you get started and guide you in these simple and joyful times with your family.

feeds.title: A Humble Place Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to a humble place! Here you'll find resources related to Charlotte Mason homeschooling, including a gentle kindergarten curriculum, Picture Study Aids and art prints, and Seasonal Art Devotions and art prints! I also share how we homeschool on the blog.

feeds.title: Ambleside Schools International Blog
feeds.description: Ambleside Schools International inspires, trains, and equips a global community of member schools and educators to provide and promote a living education as described by Charlotte Mason for the renewal of Christian education.

feeds.title: They Call Me Blessed Blog
feeds.description: I'm Ana Willis. Say goodbye to your homeschool frustrations and overwhelm! I help moms follow a clear step-by-step homeschool success path, grow their faith and knowledge of God's Word, and thrive in fulfilling their calling as a mom! Read my blog for tips on being a good mom, homeschooling, and more!

feeds.title: Raising Life Shoots Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Raising Little Shoots! A place of slow & seasonal, Charlotte Mason-inspired nature study. My books are written to deepen the connections both with your children and with the natural world around you. We believe in Charlotte Mason's philosophy- Never be within doors when you can rightly be without.

feeds.title: Afterthoughts
feeds.description: Brandy Vencel is a sinner justified by grace through the redemption that is in Christ. Afterthoughts is a place to nourish the mind. The bulk of the ideas are simply afterthoughts: thoughts that other people think of first. Anything original is purely accidental. Blog posts on books and reading, educational philosophy, home education, and mother's education.

feeds.title: Karen Glass Blog
feeds.description: Karen Glass is part of the Advisory of AmblesideOnline. She has four children, ages 13 to 27, who have been homeschooled using Charlotte Mason's methods from beginning to end. She has been studying and writing about Charlotte Mason and Classical Education for over twenty years.

feeds.title: Charlotte Mason Motherhood Blog
feeds.description: I'm Larissa, a follower of Christ and a hopelessly devoted wife, mother, and homemaker. I homeschool my children and share my experiences, exam strategies, and more. When I'm not teaching, I'm usually baking sourdough, reading a good book, or learning a new skill in the home or the kitchen.

feeds.title: Charlotte Mason France Blog
feeds.description: Charlotte Mason France is a reference site in French on Charlotte Mason's pedagogy. It is dedicated to promoting an authentic interpretation of Charlotte Mason's work. Maeva Dauplay, Sylvie Dugauquier, Sarah Eisele, and Charlotte Roman are the frequent writers, additionally guest writers are also invited.

feeds.title: Wildflowers and Marbles
feeds.description: I'm Jennifer Mackintosh, and I'm a Catholic home educator, finding the simple joys in living here in the beautiful foothills of the Appalachian Mountains. Sharing the beauty found in the ordinary moments - planning, organizing, homeschooling, and living the Catholic faith.

feeds.title: Letters from Nebby
feeds.description: This blog is about the things that interest Nebby, namely Charlotte Mason's homeschooling, and reformed Christian theology. She writes about both of these methodologies, approaches to homeschooling, book reviews, and more.

feeds.title: Charlotte Mason Mama Blog
feeds.description: I'm Jenny! Wife, momma to 7, goat enthusiast, blogger, influencer, Great Pyrenees lover, chicken photographer and admirer, and happy homesteader. We are a homeschooled family living in the Midwest on a couple of acres of land. Our goals are to raise our children, plants, and animals as holistically as possible. We strive to improve our soil through permaculture practices and respect for the already-designed process of land regeneration.
